name: Sulu Pygmy Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Sulu archipelago (bongao, jolo, tawitawi, sanga sanga, and sibutu)
description: A small woodpecker of lowland wooded areas on the Sulu Islands. Dark brown above with some white spots on the back, a white rump, throat, and underparts with faint streaking, and buffy sides of the chest.

name: Black-banded Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: North-central australia (western escarpment of arnhem land)
description: Very large black-and-white forest pigeon, found as singles or small groups in large fruiting trees beside sandstone escarpments in the Kakadu National Park region of the Northern Territory. Generally hard to find.

name: Abd al Kuri Sparrow
rangeDescription: Socotra (abd al kuri)
description: Typical “rufous sparrow”, with a striped back and a gray crown, nape, and rump. Males have a black bib, and are brighter overall, with more rufous on the face and shoulder.

name: Sunda Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Malay peninsula, and greater and lesser sundas
description: Typical Cuculus cuckoo: most adults are gray with black stripes on a white breast and belly, but some females are “hepatic”; they appear rufous overall with extensive barring. Virtually identical to Himalayan and Oriental cuckoos, which migrate through and winter in Sunda’s range; look for Sunda’s more contrasting darker gray upperparts, wider bars on the underparts, and buffier unmarked vent.

name: Bornean Swiftlet
rangeDescription: High elevations on mount kinabalu (sabah, northern borneo)
description: Endemic to the upper massif of Mount Kinabalu, Borneo (on current knowledge). This small, fast flier is extremely difficult to identify since it overlaps with the abundant, very similar Plume-toed Swiftlet (formerly a subspecies of Glossy Swiftlet).

name: Madagascar Grebe
rangeDescription: Madagascar
description: Small, dark grebe that is endemic to Madagascar. The neck is rufous and white in breeding plumage and buff in non-breeding plumage.

name: Masafuera Rayadito
rangeDescription: Alejandro selkirk island (juan fernández islands off chile)
description: Restricted to largely inaccessible Isla Selkirk (formerly Isla Masafuera) in Juan Fernández Islands, Chile, where it is uncommon and restricted to higher elevations. Favors dense fern forest and is often somewhat skulking, although can be tame and confiding when found.

name: Golden White-eye
rangeDescription: Central and southern northern mariana islands (saipan and aguijan)
description: A beautiful, unique, entirely yellowish white-eye. Bright golden yellow on the head with a paler eye-ring, yellowish-green wings, and a darker orange-yellow coloring below.

name: Creamy-bellied Antwren
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of peru (huánuco to cusco)
description: Small antwren found in the canopy of foothill forests of the eastern Andes in central Peru. Note the black cap, striped face, white wingbars, and lack of rufous in the wing.

name: Tibetan Sandgrouse
rangeDescription: Desert of eastern afghanistan to tibetan plateau
description: A sandy-colored ground bird with a thin needle-point tail and a gentle, dove-like profile. Not as well-marked as other sandgrouse: soft sandy brown with a light orange face and finely barred breast.

name: Andaman Boobook
rangeDescription: Andaman islands
description: A compact owl with brownish face and upperparts. Note the bold, rust-colored streaks running down the underparts.

name: Little Eagle
rangeDescription: Open woodland and savanna of australia (except tasmania)
description: Small, stocky eagle often mistaken for a kite. Both light and dark morphs occur in varying frequencies throughout its extensive range.

name: Barred Puffbird
rangeDescription: Humid forest of western panama to western ecuador
description: An unobtrusive bird with an oversized head and bill. Look for tiger-striped pattern—warm cinnamon-brown overall with uneven black barring.

name: Rufous Sabrewing
rangeDescription: Highlands of southern mexico (oaxaca and chiapas) to el salvador
description: Very large and spectacular hummingbird of humid forest and brushy woodland in highlands of Chiapas and northern Central America; uncommon and local. Feeds mainly at low to middle levels, often inside shady understory.

name: Buru Thrush
rangeDescription: Mid-mountain forest of buru (southern moluccas)
description: A distinctive thrush with chocolate-brown upperparts, a dark head with a conspicuous pale eye-ring, a black throat, and a white belly. Also shows rows of clean white spots on wings.

name: Spot-billed Pelican
rangeDescription: Lowlands of india to southeastern asia and philippines
description: A large pale waterbird with a hefty pinkish pouched bill marked with diagnostic dark spots on the upper mandible. The head is grizzled with a hint of a shaggy crest and the back of the neck is dark.

name: Palawan Babbler
rangeDescription: Southwestern philippines (balabac and palawan)
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland forest tangles and bamboo on Palawan and Balabac. Medium-brown above with more rufous on the tail, shoulder, and forecrown.

name: Guam Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Formerly guam (mariana islands); extinct in the wild; small captive population
description: Extinct in the wild, last reported in 1986.

name: Venezuelan Flowerpiercer
rangeDescription: Mountains of northeastern venezuela (northwestern monagas and southern sucre)
description: Small tanager-like bird with sharply hooked, slightly upturned bill, male all black and female yellow-olive. Both sexes show a white flash under the wing, better visible in flight.

name: Schlegel's Asity
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed dense forest of western madagascar
description: Chunky, olive-backed bird. Males have a black head, multi-colored bare facial skin, and yellow underparts.
